component.name: Ollama Speak
component.summary: Local Ollama chat with multilingual offline speech

description.p: Ollama Speak is a local-first Linux desktop client for chatting with Ollama models and listening to responses synthesized locally by Piper.
It provides streaming conversations, completion-model filtering, multilingual voice discovery, selectable timbre, persistent settings, and clean cancellation of generation and speech.
Consolidated release with multilingual Piper speech, reliability improvements, regression tests, and standards-based packaging.
